title: Not a croquette or paella in sight. A fantastic food experience!
text:
We loved this tour! 
The stops were at wonderful authentic restaurants with friendly and welcoming hosts. 
Other than the patatas bravas (which was tasty) the food we tried was different to what we would have ordered and really delicious.
Our guide was friendly, engaging and knowledgeable.
We cannot recommend this tour more highly.
author: megantF1639IR

title: Barcelona Food Wine Tapas
text: Lorea, thank you!   This was an evening of great food, time to chat, learn and discover much about Spain.  The food and wine were outstanding. Our guide , Lorea, surpassed all with her ease, flow of the evening and knowledge!  Thank you

title: Great “Non-Touristy “ Food Tour
text: What a wonderful experience. Lorea was extremely knowledgeable and so much fun. I would recommend this tour to anyone who wants a “non-touristy “ food tour. Outstanding!

title: Pablo Sec Tapas Tasting

title: Great food & conversation
text: Delicious food & drinks and nice conversation. This was our 7th food tour and Lorea's was above average!  We ate foods that we don't expect to find anywhere else.  Nice way to start a stay in a new city.
author: 4CalTravelers

title: Eating Europe Food Tour - Poble Sec Tapas
text: Lorea was an excellent tour guide. Very informative! Really made the experience worth the money!
author: Venture61820254595

title: Lorea is great!
text: We had a delightful evening with Lorea! The places chosen and the food and wine served were an excellent assortment of Barcelona’s tapas. She was engaging, fun, and organized with our group. Without her we would not have been aware of some excellent tapas locations, nor aware of some excellent tapas choices. The wine pairings fully complemented the dishes. A terrific way to begin our Spain adventure.
author: V7322ZXjimc

title: Left full and informed
text: Everything was wonderful. Our guide Lorea was friendly and knowledgeable. I’ve been to Barcelona before but it was great to have a local talk us through the dishes and the history. Would definitely recommend, especially early on in your trip to get ideas and recommendations for areas and restaurants later on in the trip. Thanks Lorea!
author: V5127WIchristopherf

title: Fantastic tour!
text: Lores was an amazing host! She embodied the spirit of Barcelona and was able to offer an in-depth perspective on architecture, food, and wine that we never could have imagined. Who knew a piece of toast could be so amazing!
author: meredithcG9789CV

title: Fantastic Voyage.
text: Fantastic time with Lorea. Very knowledgeable and engaging with the entire group. Fantastic food and wine pairing for places we never would’ve found on our own. Highly recommend!!!
